content: CPM2Hub_TMA (E:\Projects\CPM2\CPM2Hub_TMA; Hono+drizzle-orm 0.x + React18 + Vite; npm workspaces @gm/web @gm/server @gm/shared). Session: added payment confirmation to web app. 1) Invoice path (Telegram Stars): after openInvoice returns 'paid', PayConfirm modal (apps/web/src/components/PayConfirm.tsx) polls GET /my/downloads every 2s up to 24s for the newly-paid purchase (productId matches, id NOT in pre-invoice snapshot), then upgrades to ConfigModal showing the config code; on timeout shows toast market.confirmTimeout. payByInvoice() in Market.tsx snapshots downloads BEFORE openInvoice; also handles pending/failed/cancelled + openTelegramLink fallback. 2) Purchase confirmation: tapping a tile or its Buy button no longer charges instantly; opens BuyConfirm modal (confirmBuy state + buy() handler in Market.tsx) with price + Confirm/Cancel; buy() runs payProduct then balance path -> ConfigModal or invoice path -> PayConfirm. Starter CTA routes through the same confirm. Escrow-only products still open escrow directly. i18n keys added ru+en: market.confirmOk/Pending/Timeout/Sub/Buy/Cancel/Price. CSS added: .pay-confirm/.pc-check/.pc-loader/@keyframes pc-spin, .bc-price, .primary-btn.ghost. Verified: typecheck + 43 web tests + build all green; deployed vercel --prod -> cpm2hub.vercel.app. Server (Railway cpm2hub-production, cpm2hub-production.up.railway.app) unchanged this session.
